title: Email: Fw: Good job with metaphors in the "Sanchez's Shoulder" piece

content.subject: Fw: Good job with metaphors in the "Sanchez's Shoulder" piece

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Tom Neely <timbuktom1@gmail.com>
Sent: Tuesday, September 15, 2015 10:15 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Good job with metaphors in the "Sanchez's Shoulder" piece 
 
Well done! You used the metaphor of a road five times, including "red flag," as in an auto race.

You also might have used "dead end of the bullpen session," rather than "tail end." (Tail is more of an animal metaphor; "rear end" as in a car might have worked, but it has other undesireable connotations.

Finally, "battled injuries" is a war metaphor. Could you have written something about being broken down on the shoulder (git it?), to fit into the road metaphor? Just stuff to think about. I may be steering you into over-cuteness here. Please keep on driving to the finish line of this baseball season. Then, take the Tigers to the checkered flag in 2016.
